lines.trans: Now we can finally talk.
I am very worried about you.
I am a very simple man.
I love family and friends.
Cinema has become too complicated.
One must know when to leave now.
To leave the front of the stage.
I had a very beautiful role.
A movie about the French Revolution.
It sounds good, but I decline.
Do you prefer ending as Santa Claus?
I leave you to ponder that.
I will not give up the fight!
Good, then continue the great fight.
